between_arms.what: each arm is rescaled over itself, so the comparison is on the ranking within an arm and on the fluctuation, not on a difference of rescaled scores

method.conservation: EVcouplings column conservation of the human alignment
method.definition: DCS = conservation * norm_dynamics, RCS = conservation * (1 - norm_dynamics), DCopS and RCopS the same two products of the coupling enrichment, each rescaled 0 to 10 over the scored positions
method.dynamics: per-residue RMSF of the production run, averaged over the replicates of the arm
method.enrichment: EVcouplings coupling enrichment of the human alignment
method.normalisation: min-max over the whole simulated chain

published_cuts.why: calibrated over a set of many proteins, and the rescaling here runs over one

method.scored_region_source: the columns the EVcouplings run covers, checked against its own alignment statistics

position_set.why: human column gapped in 62.3 per cent of the alignment
human column gapped in 35.7 per cent of the alignment
human column gapped in 56.3 per cent of the alignment

primaries.why: human column gapped in 74.7 per cent of the alignment

rescue_targets.why: human column gapped in 62.3 per cent of the alignment

single_replicate_direction.what: the change in each score from the wt arm to the construct arm, recomputed with one replicate under the normalisation, beside the change the pooled score gives
